newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas ticks up after falls, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas ticks up after falls, trade thin.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures prices picked up on Tuesday morning following the fall on Monday, although the volume of trade was extremely thin.
Only 10 lots were traded by the end of the two hour morning session. These were done in a single lot in July at 9.35 pence a therm, up by 0.10 pence from Monday's settlement price.

In all months when offers were posted, they were higher than Monday's settlement level. In September even the bid, at 9.50 pence, was higher than the previous settlement price of 9.375 pence. This contrasts with the falling market on Monday, when for much of the day offers were below the previous settlement level.
By the close bids were posted in all 12 contract months against offers in 10 months, although there were times in the middle of the trading session when no bids or offers were posted at all.
